d:
Bhojpuri abhinetri akshara sinh ke lie is bar chhath puja behad khas hai. Bihar Tak ke Exclusive Interview men akshara ne chhath mahaparv se juri apni bhavnaon, aastha aur is bar ki taiyariyon ko lekar khas baten sajha kin. akshara sinh ne bataya ki unke lie chhath puja ka kya mahatv hai aur is bar yah parv unke lie kyon khas hai. dekhie akshara sinh ka khas intravyu sirph Bihar Tak par.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
